By mandating that queries answerable from the knowledge base receive a direct response first, this change ensures that the caller receives an immediate answer when available, improving efficiency and compliance with escalation policies.

The revised instruction stipulates that the agent should provide direct answers when information is available, ensuring that queries about payment methods and similar issues are resolved efficiently without unnecessary escalation.
